note: Nature. Every desc places the main elements left, right and far and ends on a walkable patch of path, sand, grass, rock or snow in the centre about 4 m from the camera; the below view shows mostly canopy or sky, so every keep names the sky and weather (docs/scene/PLAN.md §3). Season lives in the variant's light, or in vars where it changes the colour of the land.

forms.desc: a temperate mixed forest of tall beech and oak trees, a packed-earth footpath about two metres wide running straight from the camera into the far distance, thick trunks and green undergrowth of ferns along the left and right edges, the canopy closing overhead with gaps of sky, the path fading into green depth far ahead, and a clear walkable stretch of bare earth path in the centre about 4 metres from the camera
forms.keep: tall beech and oak trunks on both sides, ferns along the edges, packed-earth path running straight ahead, canopy overhead with small gaps of sky, same sky and weather, empty path in the centre
checks: 树冠在头顶合拢、露出少量天空

variants.light: Summer midday, bright sun filtering through the canopy in dappled patches on the path, deep green leaves
Early morning with soft mist hanging between the trunks, low sun behind the trees making faint light shafts, the far path fading into white haze

forms.desc: a dense grove of tall green moso bamboo, straight culms rising close together along the left and right sides of a narrow earth path covered with dry bamboo leaves, the path leading straight ahead and curving slightly right in the far distance, the bamboo tops meeting high overhead with slivers of sky, no lanterns or fences, and a clear walkable patch of leaf-covered path in the centre about 4 metres from the camera
forms.keep: tall green bamboo culms close on both sides, leaf-covered earth path leading ahead and curving right far away, bamboo tops meeting overhead with slivers of sky, same sky and weather, no fences or lanterns, empty path in the centre

variants.light: Soft daylight filtered green through the bamboo leaves, thin bright streaks of sun on the path

forms.desc: a grove of old cherry trees in full pale pink bloom on a gentle grassy slope, the trees standing in loose rows on the left and right with their branches arching over a wide gravel path, fallen petals scattered on the path and the grass, more blossoming trees fading into the far distance, no lanterns, no tents, no buildings, and a clear walkable patch of petal-strewn gravel path in the centre about 4 metres from the camera
forms.keep: old cherry trees in full pale pink bloom on both sides, branches arching over the path, wide gravel path with fallen petals, grass under the trees, same sky and weather, no lanterns or buildings, empty path in the centre

variants.light: Bright spring afternoon, pale blue sky with thin high clouds showing through the blossoms, soft sun from the left

forms.desc: a hillside woodland of Japanese maples in full autumn colour, red, orange and yellow leaves on the trees along the left and right edges, a narrow path of flat stepping stones and packed earth covered with fallen red leaves leading straight ahead, a mossy bank on the left, the coloured canopy arching overhead with patches of sky, and a clear walkable patch of leaf-covered path in the centre about 4 metres from the camera
forms.keep: maples in red, orange and yellow on both sides, mossy bank on the left, path of stepping stones and earth with fallen red leaves, coloured canopy overhead with patches of sky, same sky and weather, empty path in the centre

variants.light: Late autumn afternoon, low warm sun from the right lighting the leaves from behind so they glow, clear sky

forms.desc: a small clearing in a tropical rainforest, huge buttressed tree trunks with hanging lianas on the left and right, large-leaved banana plants, palms and dense ferns forming green walls around the edges, a tangle of vines and foliage across the far side, the high canopy overhead with an opening of sky, damp dark soil with a few roots, and a clear walkable patch of flat bare soil in the centre about 4 metres from the camera
forms.keep: buttressed trunks with hanging lianas left and right, banana plants, palms and ferns around the edges, dense foliage across the far side, high canopy with an opening of sky, damp dark soil, same sky and weather, empty centre ground

variants.light: Humid midday, a shaft of sunlight falling through the canopy opening onto the clearing, the edges in green shade, faint haze in the air

forms.desc: a wide empty sandy beach with fine pale sand, the sea filling the far half of the view with small waves breaking on the shore about 15 metres away, the straight horizon line far ahead, a low grassy dune with beach grass at the left edge, a few smooth pieces of driftwood on the sand at the right edge, no umbrellas, no boats, no piers, and a clear walkable patch of smooth dry sand in the centre about 4 metres from the camera

variants.light: Bright noon sun high overhead, deep blue sky with a few white cumulus clouds, turquoise water, short shadows
Sunset, the sun low just above the horizon slightly right of centre, orange and pink sky, a golden path of light on the water, long soft shadows

forms.desc: a rugged rocky coastline of dark grey granite, large weathered boulders piled along the left side, a lower rock shelf sloping to the sea on the right with white surf breaking against it, the open sea and horizon across the far side, a few tide pools in the rock, no lighthouse, no buildings, and a clear walkable patch of flat dry rock shelf in the centre about 4 metres from the camera

forms.desc: a waterfall about 12 metres high pouring down a mossy dark rock cliff in the far centre into a clear green pool, the pool filling the middle distance, wet ferns and moss on rock walls along the left and right, a broad flat bank of dry grey slate in the foreground at the near edge of the pool, nothing built and no railings, and a clear walkable patch of flat dry slate in the centre about 4 metres from the camera, well back from the water
